requirements.requirement: All existing content under /srv/inventory is owned by inventorysvc.
requirements.summary: The final recursive inventory shows the root, data directory, and both files owned by inventorysvc, including after restart.

requirements.requirement: The inventory-readers group can read the existing data.
requirements.summary: All directories are group-readable/traversable at 0750 and all files are group-readable at 0640. A direct inventory-readers access test also successfully read records.csv before restart, and access checks passed afterward.

requirements.requirement: Users outside the owner and inventory-readers group cannot access /srv/inventory.
requirements.summary: Every inventory object has zero permissions for others. Direct tests verified that an unrelated user could neither traverse the root nor read a data file, both before and after restart.
The same two files remain present, with SHA-256 hashes identical to the preparation baseline before repair, after repair, and after restart.

overall_summary: All material outcomes are satisfied with direct final-state and behavioral evidence. Ownership and permissions are correct, authorized readers can read without writing, unrelated users are denied, and the original files and hashes were preserved. The mandatory node-restart protocol is complete and agrees with the fixed lifecycle boot observations.
